$comment: Hand-maintained hints for build-comparison.mjs. Everything here is a hint: the script checks each one against the Custom Elements Manifest (CEM) and the web component source, and records whether it held.

classToTag.$comment: CCA class -> web component tag(s). null = no web component counterpart, with a reason. Classes not listed fall back to a direct selector match. A conditional target is { tag, when, set? }; `when` is one of { input, equals } (an input on the class), { parentInput: 'Parent.input', equals } (an input on the parent component) or { hostElement } (the element the directive sits on).

unmappedReasons.Label: Wraps any projected input. Each web component input renders its own label (label-text slot).
unmappedReasons.RowDirective: Flexbox grid only. The web components implement CSS Grid only (cds-grid / cds-column); the flexbox grid exists only as @carbon/styles classes. Kept as an Angular-only class directive.
unmappedReasons.HeaderGlobal: Plain layout container. The web component header has no global-bar element.
unmappedReasons.OverflowMenuCustomPane: Free-form pane. The closest is cds-overflow-menu-body with custom children.
unmappedReasons.DropdownList: Model-driven list (ListItem[]). Web components use cds-dropdown-item / cds-multi-select-item children.
unmappedReasons.AbstractDropdownView: Removed in v7: internal. Abstract base class for DropdownList.
unmappedReasons.ScrollableList: Removed in v7: internal. Behaviour is inside the web component listbox.
unmappedReasons.TableHeaderDecorator: Use the decorator / ai-label slot on the cell.
unmappedReasons.TableHeadCellLabel: Removed in v7: internal. cds-table-header-cell text is its default slot.
unmappedReasons.ExpandedRowHover: Removed in v7: internal. Hover state is inside cds-table-expanded-row.
unmappedReasons.AlertModal: Created by a service (ModalService). Can be rebuilt on cds-modal, but it is not a tag.
unmappedReasons.BaseModal: Removed in v7 with the modal rewrite. Custom modals extend it today (ModalService), so the rewrite needs a replacement for service-created modals.
unmappedReasons.Dialog: Removed in v7: internal. Base popover dialog used by OverflowMenu. Replaced by cds-popover / cds-overflow-menu-body.
unmappedReasons.DialogDirective: Removed in v7: internal. Base dialog directive. Replaced by cds-popover.
unmappedReasons.IconTab: No icon-only tab element. cds-tab takes an icon in its default slot; check cds-tabs type="icon" support.
unmappedReasons.TabHeader: Removed in v7: internal. cds-tab is the header. Panels are separate elements linked by id.
unmappedReasons.TabHeaderGroup: No grouped tab header in web components.
unmappedReasons.TabHeaderGroupVertical: No grouped tab header in web components.
unmappedReasons.TabsVerticalGrouped: No grouped vertical tabs in web components.
unmappedReasons.Placeholder: Angular-only. Hosts dynamically created components (modal / dialog services).
unmappedReasons.ThemeDirective: No theme element in web components. Use the @carbon/styles theme classes or cds-layer.
unmappedReasons.AspectRatioDirective: No aspect-ratio element in web components. CSS utility.

slotDirectives.$comment: CCA content-marker directives -> a slot on a parent web component. Each is kept as a tiny directive that sets the slot attribute (host: { slot: '<name>' }), so v6 markup keeps working. "" = default slot (no attribute). The script checks that the slot exists.

ExpandableTileBelowFoldDirective.note: Below-the-fold content is the default slot; the directive becomes a no-op kept for compatibility.

ToggletipLabel.note: The toggletip label is the default slot; the directive becomes a no-op kept for compatibility.

renameCandidates.$comment: Known renames: when a CCA input has NO exact match (same name, same attribute or case-insensitive), these web component names are tried in order. Only real alternate names belong here; same-name entries are pointless because the exact match runs first. A candidate counts only if the tag has it.

variantInputs.$comment: Inputs that switch to a different web component tag instead of setting a prop. {tag} = the target tag, {stem} = the tag without `cds-`. Used only when that tag exists.

structuralInputs.$comment: Model-driven inputs (Class.input). kind: renderChildren = the wrapper renders web component children from the array (light DOM, so they land in the host's slots) and still projects <ng-content>; adapter = model fields map onto host props; rewrite = no backwards compatibility. In itemMap, `item` is the array entry, `index` its position, `host` the wrapper. Prop names in itemMap / props are checked against the CEM.

names.items: Child elements (*-item) instead of an items array.
names.model: Child elements instead of a model object.

child.notes: item.template renders inside cds-breadcrumb-item instead of the link (context { $implicit: item }). item.route / routeExtras: a click listener calls router.navigate() and emits `navigation`, because the link's <a> is in shadow DOM.

overflow.rule: items.length > threshold: render items[0], then <cds-breadcrumb-item><cds-overflow-menu breadcrumb><cds-overflow-menu-body> with one <cds-overflow-menu-item> per items[1 … length-3], then items[length-2] and items[length-1]
overflow.notes: Same split as CCA (first, overflowItems, secondLast, last). cds-breadcrumb-overflow-menu is deprecated upstream in favour of cds-overflow-menu[breadcrumb].

slots.icon: item.icon (string icon or TemplateRef, context item.iconContext)

TreeViewComponent.tree.notes: nodeOf() maps the event's cds-tree-node back to its Node (e.g. a WeakMap filled while rendering). item.label as a TemplateRef has no target: cds-tree-node renders its label from the `label` prop and has no label slot. selectable / gap / value / labelContext have no counterpart.

Pagination.model.notes: v6 semantics: the consumer sets model.currentPage in (selectPage); the host binding re-reads the model on change detection. Keep until table v2 / pagination v2.

HeaderNavigation.navigationItems.notes: item.trigger (click / mouseover) has no counterpart. route / routeExtras: click listener + router.navigate().

SideNav.navigationItems.notes: cds-side-nav expects its links inside <cds-side-nav-items>. route / routeExtras: click listener + router.navigate().

SideNavMenu.menuItems.notes: item.isSubMenu has no counterpart. route / routeExtras: click listener + router.navigate().

Pagination.itemsPerPageOptions.notes: cds-pagination reads its page sizes from <cds-select-item> children.

TreeNodeComponent.node.notes: Same field map as TreeViewComponent.tree; node.children renders through TreeNodeComponent.children.

ColumnDirective.columnNumbers.notes: CCA keys are breakpoints ({ lg: 4, md: 2 }); cds-column takes one ColumnSpec per breakpoint. `offsets` folds into the same specs. CCA also accepts 'auto' / 'nobreak' values: check against ColumnSpec when curating.

PaginationNav.model.notes: numOfItemsToShow -> itemsShown is a plain rename.

Notification.notificationObj.notes: notificationObj.template renders in the default slot. smart / target / closeLabel have no counterpart. NotificationService keeps creating these programmatically.

Toast.notificationObj.notes: notificationObj.template renders in the default slot. smart / target / closeLabel have no counterpart. NotificationService keeps creating these programmatically.

events.click: item.click is a Subject ? item.click.next({ event: $event, action: item }) : item.click({ event: $event, action: item })

ActionableNotification.notificationObj.notes: notificationObj.template renders in the default slot. smart / target / closeLabel have no counterpart. NotificationService keeps creating these programmatically. notificationObj.actionsTemplate renders in the action slot; notificationObj.links have no counterpart.

rewrites.$comment: Components whose API is replaced, not carried over. No backwards-compatible aliases: every legacy input/output is deprecated and the schematic leaves a TODO. Comparison rows are still produced so the deprecation list is complete.
rewrites.Table: Model-driven table (TableModel) is replaced by cds-table child elements.
rewrites.TableHead: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-head children.
rewrites.TableBody: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-body children.
rewrites.TableRowComponent: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-row.
rewrites.TableData: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-cell.
rewrites.TableHeadCell: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-header-cell.
rewrites.TableExpandedRow: Rendered from TableModel; replaced by cds-table-expanded-row.
rewrites.Dropdown: ListItem[]-driven dropdown is replaced by cds-dropdown / cds-multi-select with item children.
rewrites.ComboBox: ListItem[]-driven combo box is replaced by cds-combo-box / cds-multi-select (filterable) with item children.
rewrites.Modal: Replaced by cds-modal and its part elements.
rewrites.DatePicker: cds-date-picker is skipped by the generator (flatpickr, ADR 0021). Rewrite on cds-preview-date-picker.
rewrites.DatePickerInput: cds-date-picker-input is skipped by the generator (flatpickr, ADR 0021). Rewrite on cds-preview-date-picker-input.

generatorSkippedTags.$comment: Copy of SKIPPED_TAGS in carbon/packages/angular/tasks/generate-wrappers/index.js (ADR 0021: flatpickr). A CCA class that targets one of these has no generated wrapper.

angularOnlyInputs.$comment: Inputs that exist for Angular integration, not for the view. They are kept on the wrapper even with no web component counterpart.

angularOnlyFallback.$comment: Classes that keep an Angular-only implementation when their web component target's `when` doesn't hold.
angularOnlyFallback.GridDirective: useCssGrid=false (the default): keep the flexbox class directive.
angularOnlyFallback.ColumnDirective: Inside a flexbox grid: keep the flexbox class directive.
angularOnlyFallback.RowDirective: Flexbox grid only: keep the class directive.

router.$comment: Tags with an `href` prop (computed from the CEM) get Angular router support through one shared directive instead of per-component route inputs.
router.directive: [routerLink] on any cds-* tag with an href: sets the host's `href` to router.serializeUrl(urlTree) so the web component renders a real <a> (middle-click / new tab work); on a plain left click with no target it calls preventDefault() and router.navigateByUrl(). routerLinkActive maps to the tag's active prop (active / isActive / isCurrentPage).
